title: A Atlas for the Ledger
author: Orsen Blackwood
blurb: Ansel Pemberton, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
